purpose: Separate practical mesh/time-step differences before selecting production discretization.

field_comparison.mask: pairwise intersection of valid fluid points, with excluded fractions reported
field_comparison.pressure: subtract each pressure mean on the common full-domain fluid mask before L2 comparison
field_comparison.wake_roi: x from minimum obstacle center x to maximum(center x + half bounding-box diagonal) + 6 Lref; y bounds use center y +/- half bounding-box diagonal plus 2 Lref; full z; clipped to domain

limitations: Thresholds are exploratory study design choices, not externally established physical tolerances.
A two-mesh comparison is a discrepancy estimate, not a mesh-convergence proof.
The fine mesh retains adaptive stepping; this does not completely isolate spatial discretization.
The independently initialized fine run ends at tau 40; no fine late-time tau 320-400 trajectory is claimed.
Passing this training geometry does not validate all other families or authorize automatic bulk generation.
